label: Town of Bridgewater
header:
# Town of Bridgewater municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Bridgewater official website, Selectboard page: lists Owen Astbury (Chair), Steve Tarleton, and Norman (Nope) Martin.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the same three Bridgewater Selectboard members (Norman Martin).
Town of Bridgewater, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026): Article 5 re-elected Stephen Tarleton (three-year term) in 2026.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Nancy Robinson as Town Clerk of Bridgewater.

Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists Nancy Robinson as Town Clerk (term printed 2022-2025; Bridgewater elects its clerk for three-year terms, and the Secretary of State's January 2026 Guide lists her currently).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Melissa Spear as Town Treasurer of Bridgewater.
Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists Melissa Spear as Town Treasurer (term printed 2022-2025; see the clerk post's note).
Town of Bridgewater, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026): Article 1 elected Greg Jenne Moderator by voice vote in 2026.

Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists the Listers as Marsha Fraser (term printed 2024-2025), Victoria Young (2023-2026), and Kaleb McIntire (2024-2027). Only McIntire's printed term runs past the March 2026 town meeting; the other two seats' outcomes are published in no official source, so only McIntire is recorded.
Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists Mary Oldenburg as Delinquent Tax Collector (term printed 2024-2027).

Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists the Cemetery Commissioners as Roy (Butch) Wardwell (term printed 2022-2025), Gregory Jenne (2023-2026), and Owen Astbury (2024-2027).

Town of Bridgewater, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026): Article 5 elected Gregory Jenne Cemetery Commissioner (three-year term) in 2026. Wardwell's seat's outcome after 2025 is published in no official source, so only Jenne and Astbury are recorded.
Town of Bridgewater, Town Meeting Minutes (March 3, 2026): Article 5 elected W. John Blanchard Town Constable (one-year term) in 2026.
Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists Warren John Blanchard as Town Constable (term printed 2024-2025).

Town of Bridgewater FY2024 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' (report p. 9): lists a single Trustee of Public Funds, Mary Oldenburg (term printed 2022-2025). The seat's outcome after 2025 is published in no official source, so no holder is recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Bridgewater justices of the peace: Gregory Jenne, Gloria Martin, Donna Williamson, Justin Wardwell, and Jerry Oppenheimber (the listing's spelling).

Town of Bridgewater official website, Board of Civil Authority page: lists the justices of the peace as Greg Jenne, Gloria Martin, Jerry Oppenheimer, Justin Wardwell, and Donna Williamson. The town prints 'Oppenheimer' (also in the FY2024 Town Report); that form is recorded, with the Secretary of State listing's 'Oppenheimber' kept as the ballot name.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Bridgewater justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
